title: Chapter 721
text:
As a famous Beyond Grade A organization, the location of the Hidden Red Robe Abbey's headquarters was publicly known. It was located in the Gelock Star Cluster and was known as the 'Palace of Hidden Spells'.

The Palace of Hidden Spells was an enormous palace floating in the universe. This palace itself was Austin's Mage Tower, and it was used as the base of the Hidden Red Robe Abbey.

A Mage Tower was an important piece of equipment for Mages. Be it in battle or research, it could be used. As the Mage Tower of a Beyond Grade A Mage, it was said that the Palace of Hidden Spells had forty-eight thousand runic arrays and had perfect attack, defense, movement, life support, energy, and so on. Furthermore, its projection could be seen in hundreds of secondary dimensions, and it could leave the main universe and enter the secondary dimensions at any time.

In terms of equipment quality, Austin's Palace of Hidden Spells surpassed orange equipment and reached the level of 'Universal Treasure'. It was the highest grade of gold equipment.

The spaceship slowly approached the Palace of Hidden Spells. Han Xiao and the other two looked through the porthole and observed this famous Mage Palace from afar.

The Palace of Hidden Spells was grand and magnificent. It was built with Adamantine and Mithril as its foundation and decorated with all kinds of colorful magic crystals. It was like a dream-like cosmic castle, with many layers and many sub-towers scattered around it. Magic Radiance surged like tides and enveloped the luxurious palace, covering it with colorful mist. Countless energy arrays were distributed on the protective shield, absorbing dark energy from the universe and flashing with complicated rune circuits.

"How magnificent." Fu Ding had a look of admiration.

"How magnificent." Marian's tone was respectful.

"So rich." Han Xiao squeezed out an envious voice from between his teeth. His focus was obviously different from others.

If Mechanics were businessmen, then Mages were tycoons, especially Mages at Austin's level. Even Han Xiao could not help but feel envious.

Han Xiao sent a landing request to the Palace of Hidden Spells. After receiving permission, he piloted the spaceship toward the spaceport.

At this time, there were many spaceships of various models docked at the spaceport. They were all Mages from different Star Systems who came to study. The Palace of Hidden Spells had always been open to the outside world, and countless Mages stayed there to study magic. It was very prosperous.

The Hidden Red Robe Abbey was a transcendent neutral magic organization. Austin did not work with Star Cluster civilizations, nor did he expand his forces. He allowed most of the Order Mages to join the Hidden Red Robe Abbey to cultivate, share their knowledge, and increase their membership level, allowing them to browse more advanced magic knowledge. The organization structure was loose, but it had more members than Bloodshed Land. Only the Forbidden Sorcerers and a few other troops were directly under Austin.

According to Han Xiao's understanding, the Hidden Red Robe Abbey was a private magic school. Austin was the headmaster, and the direct officers were the leaders and lecturers at all levels. The Forbidden Sorcerers were equivalent to the student council or the school's disciplinary team.

The three of them stepped onto the dock of the spaceport, and there was already someone waiting to receive them. It was the Forbidden Sorcerer who had taken Lagi away, Wizard Desoro.

"We haven't seen each other for more than ten years. You haven't been promoted yet?" Han Xiao remembered him and joked.

"You must be joking. His Excellency Spell Master is in the main hall, please follow me."

Desoro's attitude was even more respectful than before. Ten years ago, he still dared to fight with Han Xiao. Now, he no longer dared to fight with him.

The few of them chatted casually as they walked into the Palace of Hidden Spells and headed to the main hall.

"The energy level here is so high." Marian took a few deep breaths and was in high spirits.

"Yes, the Palace of Hidden Spells absorbs the dark energy and magic elements drifting in the universe and increases the magic density here through the Energy Gathering Magic Array. The efficiency of Mages meditating here is amazing, and the abundant magic energy makes it convenient for all kinds of magic research … Even if you're not a Mage, breathing the air here will make you energetic."

Desoro explained.

Fu Ding pinched his forehead and said in surprise, "My Psychic power seems to be suppressed. I can't release it too far. There will be a huge hindrance if it exceeds fifty meters."

"It's like this," Desoro said. "Because many Mages stay here to do their own magic research, they will set up all kinds of restrictions to prevent mental detection. It's taboo to release Psychic power here."

The few of them entered the main hall, and the scene inside jumped into their eyes.

Countless thick magic books floated in the air, shining with a brilliance that resembled silver stars. It was like a sky full of stars, a dazzling river of stars. Several hundred half-transparent Austins sat cross-legged in the air, reading different books. They were all clones projected by celestial bodies. Austin's original body sat on the throne with his eyes closed and his chubby little face supported by the back of his hand. He seemed to be sleeping soundly, and there seemed to be sparkling water hanging from the corner of his mouth.

As soon as Han Xiao and the others walked in, Austin sensed something. His brows moved, and he woke up. He opened his eyes and yawned sleepily.

"Black Star, you do the spicy part."

Austin wiped the saliva from the corner of his mouth. The saliva turned into a blue magic dragon the size of a finger and flew away happily.

"Mr. Magus."

Han Xiao nodded and greeted him. Fu Ding and Marian followed suit.

Desoro tactfully left and closed the door.

"It's rare for you to come to me for help. Let's talk in detail later. Let me see what Sisko did to you first."

Austin walked down from the throne, and the clones that were projected from the stars returned to his original body like birds returning to their nest, disappearing without a trace. He walked to Han Xiao with his short legs. His height only reached Han Xiao's waist, and the loose red robe that did not fit him dragged on the ground like a red carpet.

Austin shook his head. His feet left the ground and rose to the same height as Han Xiao. He extended his short and tender finger and gently tapped on Han Xiao's forehead. He looked at the Psychic poison and exclaimed.

"How is it?" Han Xiao's heart skipped a beat. A Beyond Grade A was actually moved. Was there some hidden danger in his situation?

"I see. This is a bit troublesome …"

Austin retracted his finger, put his hands behind his back, and circled around Han Xiao. "How much do you know about Sisko?"

"Not really …" Han Xiao thought about it. He remembered the information that the players had compiled in his previous life, but there were very few things about Sisko. Plus, the players did not have access to the upper echelons, so there should be some information that he did not know.

"Alright, I have to tell you first. The official name of this Psychic poison should be called Soul Embryo. I can't help you get rid of it."

Han Xiao was shocked. "Even a Beyond Grade A Mage like you can't do it?"

"Magic isn't omnipotent." Austin shook his head helplessly.

Lagi said the same thing …

Han Xiao mumbled softly.

"Let me explain it to you. Just like how I occasionally create magic scrolls myself, Sisko will also use activation techniques to store his Psychic attacks. The one-time weapons that we Beyond Grade As create will be circulated on the black market and sold for sky-high prices. The one that injured you this time was a one-time Psychic weapon created by Sisko.

To be exact, it not only contained Sisko's Psychic energy but also another type of energy.

As far as I know, before Sisko became a Beyond Grade A, he once roamed the Ancient Star Desert, an ancient Star Field. There, he obtained a Universal Treasure called the Evolution Cube. I don't know which lost civilization it was. "

Hearing this, Han Xiao was slightly stunned.

It was actually this thing?

This time, Fu Ding asked curiously, "What does the Evolution Cube do?"

Austin glanced at him and felt that Fu Ding was pleasing to the eye, so he explained, "Sisko hid the Evolution Cube very well. I have never seen what the Evolution Cube looks like, nor do I know how it works. I only know two things about how Sisko used it.

"First, the Evolution Cube can stimulate the potential of a species and allow them to evolve greatly in a short period of time, automatically adjusting to the genetic sequence with the highest compatibility. Sisko used the Evolution Cube to complete the Beyond Grade A Species transformation. His awakening of the Atavistic Bloodline was also thanks to the Evolution Cube."

Marian's breathing became heavy. "This treasure can lower the threshold of Beyond Grade A?"

"Not only that," Austin said slowly.

Austin slowly said, "Sisko also used the Evolution Cube to affect all of his race, completing the evolution of an entire civilization. He easily walked through a process that other civilizations would take tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years to complete. His race has already reached the perfect state of their genetic sequence. Their body, lifespan, intelligence, and other qualities are all far beyond normal species. The strength of a newborn is close to that of a Grade C Super."

Fu Ding's expression was shocked. "Such a treasure actually exists? This is too unbelievable. Won't the other organizations covet such a powerful thing?"

"Of course, there are people who are tempted. The Arcane Church took the initiative to approach, and Sisko made a deal with them. He was willing to use the Evolution Cube to serve the Arcane Church in exchange for the protection of the entire civilization from the Arcane Church.

Originally, Sisko's civilization was just an ordinary Star System civilization, but it developed rapidly and showed signs of becoming the next Star Cluster civilization. Although there are already Star Cluster civilizations in his area, Sisko has the support of the Arcane Church. His competitors do not dare to openly suppress him and can only watch as he rises. "

Han Xiao nodded. This was similar to the information he had. Sisko was focused on leading his civilization and managing his own territory. He did not like to participate in the conflicts of other regions.

He felt that with Sisko's personality, the possibility of him participating in the secret war was very low.

Fu Ding was somewhat impressed. "It sounds like he's the hero of his own civilization."

Austin did not deny it and continued. "The second effect of the Evolution Cube is to increase mental strength. The upper limit is unknown, so Sisko's psychic power is unbelievably strong. In terms of mental strength alone, it's even higher than mine. Most importantly, the power of the Evolution Cube is entangled with his psychic power, resulting in a special reaction, causing his psychic power to contain a strange life force."

"The psychokinesis poison in your spiritual brain is actually an embryo for nurturing a new soul. Hmm, it's the secondary personality you speak of … This soul that hasn't been born yet has already taken root in your spiritual world and is connected to your own soul. Although I can destroy it, your body will suffer irreversible damage," Austin said with a shrug.

"Irreversible damage means …" Han Xiao asked carefully.

"I'm not sure. If you want to try, I don't mind." Austin laughed.

Han Xiao felt a headache coming. "Is there no other way?"

"That's not the case." Austin smiled mysteriously. "If I or Ames suffered the same injury as you, we would be able to recover easily."

Han Xiao's eyes flickered, and he seemed to have understood something. "You mean …"

"Although Sisko's psychic power is strong, at the Beyond Grade A level, it's far from unsolvable. The mind of a Beyond Grade A Super is extremely strong. As long as you can become a Beyond Grade A Super, you won't need the help of others and will be able to recover on your own."

Austin stared at Han Xiao with great interest and added, "You know, if it were anyone else, I wouldn't have said such a thing to them, but you're different. I've long seen your potential. You might be able to become a Beyond Grade A Super before you're corrupted and get out of this predicament."

"… Actually, there's a simpler way." Han Xiao could not help but say, "You can be the judge and ask Sisko for help. He'll definitely know how to resolve his own attack. You should have a good relationship with him, right?"

"Nonsense, I don't know him. I'm not close to him." Austin denied it without thinking.

Han Xiao rolled his eyes.
